verdict.rationale: The only related evidence says Devin can run independent tasks at the same time. It does not document launching several attempts at the same task or comparing their results before choosing one. Manually starting duplicate sessions would be a user-side workaround, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run several task attempts in parallel and compare results before choosing one

citations.quote: Carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously.
